faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIMHANS Junior Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIMHANS Junior Office Assistant position is 25th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com/BBA/B.Sc./B.A degree with at least one year of administrative and HRM experience, or a Master's degree in M.Com/MBA/M.Sc/M.A to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Office Assistant post in the NIMHANS recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Office Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Office Assistant position is 30 years. There is no minimum age specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Office Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Office Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Office Assistant role will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NIMHANS Junior Office Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the NIMHANS Junior Office Assistant positions. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Office Assistant position at NIMHANS is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
